hints.title: Conceptual hint
hints.general_description: Think about how many different proton environments are present and how splitting patterns can reveal neighboring hydrogens.

hints.title: Feature-directed hint
hints.general_description: Focus on the signals near 1.2 ppm and 3.6 ppm. One appears as a triplet and the other as a quartet. What kinds of neighboring proton groups produce those patterns?

hints.title: Interpretive hint
hints.general_description: A 3H triplet next to a 2H quartet strongly suggests a CH₃–CH₂ fragment. The more downfield CH₂ signal suggests that it is attached to an electronegative atom.

hints.title: Bottom-out hint
hints.general_description: The molecule contains a CH₃–CH₂–OH group. Use the remaining proton signal, corresponding to the hydroxyl proton, to confirm the structure as ethanol.
